components.name: Ficha
components.description: Parchment card with the parcel description, five lines max.
components.html: FRASCO DE LÍQUIDO AZUL. LLEVA EL SELLO DEL GREMIO DE ALQUIMISTAS. ORIGEN: VALMORA.
components.css: .ds-ficha { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; image-rendering: pixelated; width: 600px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #f4f4f4; color: #333c57; border: 4px solid #1a1c2c; font-size: 28px; line-height: 36px; }

components.name: Stamp on card
components.description: Seal frame stamped on the card after a decision.
components.css: .ds-stamp { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; image-rendering: pixelated; display: inline-block; padding: 8px 16px 8px 72px; background: #f4f4f4; color: #38b764; border: 4px solid #38b764; font-size: 28px; }

components.name: Wait seconds
components.description: Elapsed wait beside the clerk; colour escalates with time.
components.css: .ds-wait { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; image-rendering: pixelated; font-size: 56px; color: #ffcd75; text-shadow: 4px 0 #1a1c2c, -4px 0 #1a1c2c, 0 4px #1a1c2c, 0 -4px #1a1c2c; background: #1a1c2c; padding: 8px; }

components.name: Points plate
components.description: Bottom plate: points in the counter colour, queue on the right.
components.css: .ds-points { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; image-rendering: pixelated; width: 600px; padding: 16px 32px; background: #1a1c2c; border: 4px solid #333c57; color: #566c86; font-size: 28px; } .ds-points b { display: block; color: #a7f070; font-size: 112px; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Phase banner
components.description: Full-width announcement at each phase change.
components.css: .ds-phase { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; image-rendering: pixelated; text-align: center; padding: 16px; background: #29366f; border-top: 4px solid #ffcd75; border-bottom: 4px solid #ffcd75; color: #ffcd75; font-size: 28px; } .ds-phase b { display: block; color: #f4f4f4; font-size: 56px; }

components.name: Simulated tag
components.description: Shown whenever ?mock is on; never red.
components.css: .ds-sim { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; image-rendering: pixelated; padding: 4px 12px; background: #333c57; color: #f4f4f4; font-size: 28px; }

narrative.overview: An airport security checkpoint at night, two identical lanes: same luggage, same instant, same rulebook. Latency reads as a consequence, trays heaping in the DeepSeek cart while the Jev belt stays clear. 480x270 logical pixels, 16-colour palette, all art authored in code.
keyCharacteristics: One 480x270 canvas, three 160 px counters, integer upscale.
Authored 5x7 bitmap capitals, Spanish decimal comma.
Flat pixel plates, no bevel, blur, radius or gradient.
One colour per counter; seals carry colour, shape and icon.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Seal red always means something went wrong; labels sit on slate.

rules.name: The Palette Lock
rules.body: No colour outside the sixteen; overlays only darken with night.

rules.name: Honest Belt
rules.body: Parcel x is its true time-to-deadline; the jam shows in the pit heap and the wait seconds.

dos: Do keep the three counters identical in layout.
Do highlight the LLM in yellow where it is best.
donts: Don't use em-dashes, eyebrow labels or decorative dots.
Don't pack or reorder parcels to dramatise the jam.
